reader_question: Of the people whose Medicaid or CHIP coverage came up for renewal, how many had a decision, how many were not cut off for paperwork, and how many kept coverage?
grade_line: Documented: renewal outcomes the states reported to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
title: Of 76.7 million Medicaid and CHIP renewals due from April 2023 to March 2024, 49.0 million kept coverage and 16.0 million ended for a procedural reason.
measure_line: Medicaid and CHIP renewals due from April 2023 to March 2024, summed over the 12 months, by what happened to each, United States; a person due in two of the months counts twice
notes: Each stage holds only the renewals still in the stage above it. Pending renewals are set apart: the states had not decided them three months after they were due.
alt: Four bars from one left edge, each shorter than the one above. Of 76.7 million renewals due, 71.9 million were decided and 4.9 million were pending; 55.9 million were not ended for a procedural reason, after 16.0 million were; 49.0 million kept coverage, after 6.9 million were found ineligible.

source_line: Source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Medicaid and CHIP Updated Renewal Outcomes, renewals due April 2023 to March 2024, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Stages summed by Oath & Action from the national rows; pending renewals set apart.
